title: Kirby Problem 4.42
exact_target: Which punctured simply connected four-manifolds slice every knot, and can ordinary sliceness detect exotic smooth structures?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, supplied problems.json, record 2918 (KP-4.42), Kirby's Problems in Low-Dimensional Topology. Catalogue identity and source transcription; CC BY 4.0.
K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology, Problem 4.42. Expanded formulation of the supplied catalogue statement.

status_qualification: Retains the named tests without claiming that every listed subcase remains open; ordinary sliceness does not require a null-homologous disk.
